title: Adam Vinatieri: I love the Patriots, but Carlie Irsay-Gordon was my choice to induct me

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Adam Vinatieri: I love the Patriots, but Carlie Irsay-Gordon was my choice to induct me
sources.description: "I love both organizations," Vinatieri said. "Living in Indy, what the Irsay family meant to me, Jim just meant the world bringing me into that organization, and Carlie I'm so excited watching her taking over her dad's legacy."
